title: CI now also runs on the merge queue
summary: The CI workflow gains a `merge_group` trigger alongside `pull_request` and `push`. Nothing inside the pipeline changes: the same jobs that gate a pull request now also run on the merge queue's own queue branch, which is the only way the required checks can be satisfied there before a queued PR is merged. The blast radius is the trigger surface of the workflow, not its steps.
